'''Darknon Beacon''' was a [[Navigational beacon/Legends|navigational beacon]] that used to guide incoming traffic to [[Darknon Station]] around the hazardous [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Darknon Beacon was a darkened hulk of machinery. Hovering in a station position relative to Darknon Station, the Beacon's [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]] had run out many years previously. The interior of the beacon had a pressurized command center and crew quarters but they have long been abandoned and de-pressurized.
